_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first; ADR-022 real OpenRegister ObjectService API only
_meta.description: Tier 3 — Wet Fido & Treasurystatuut compliance for Dutch decentralised governments (gemeenten/provincies/waterschappen/GR). Declares eight schemas: Treasurystatuut, KasgeldLimiet, RenteRisicoNorm, SchatkistbankierenSaldo, Lening, Derivaat, QuartaalrapportageFido and TreasuryParagraaf. All limiet-math (kasgeldlimiet rolling-3-month average, rente-risiconorm 4-year forward projection, schatkistbankieren drempelbedrag, quarterly-rapportage roll-up) is declarative metadata: x-openregister-aggregations + x-openregister-lifecycle. The single ADR-031 exception-path guard (OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\FidoTreasuryGuard) enforces the three cross-field preconditions the declarative DSL cannot yet express: a Lening may only be recorded once any kasgeldlimiet / rente-risiconorm / signing-mandate breach carries an override-rationale, a Derivaat may only be recorded with a RUDDO hedging-link whose notional does not exceed the hedged exposure and whose counterparty rating is single-A or better, and a QuartaalrapportageFido may only be submitted once both the treasurer and concerncontroller sign-offs are present. Seed objects ship one Treasurystatuut, one Lening, one KasgeldLimiet template, one Derivaat, one RenteRisicoNorm and one SchatkistbankierenSaldo worked example per design.md.

fido-normcatalogus.description: FidoNormcatalogus statutory kasgeldlimiet percentages per organisatie-type (Wet Fido Annex II). Maintained as fragment metadata so a wets-wijziging is a data-edit, not a code-deploy; the kasgeld-limiet percentage default is auto-selected from the organisation's organisationType on first KasgeldLimiet record.

Treasurystatuut.title: Treasurystatuut
Treasurystatuut.description: Versioned local treasury risk policy adopted by raad/staten/AB once per term. Encodes the signing-mandate matrix (role × amount × instrument), permitted instruments and counterparty allowlist within the Wet Fido envelope. Exactly one version is 'adopted' per organisation at any moment; adopting a new version supersedes the prior one. Lifecycle: draft → approved → adopted → superseded.

KasgeldLimiet.title: Kasgeldlimiet
KasgeldLimiet.description: Daily short-term debt ceiling per Wet Fido. The ceiling is percentage × vastgestelde begroting per 1 januari, where percentage is the FidoNormcatalogus statutory value for the organisatie-type. Current exposure is the rolling 3-month average of net short-term debt; a declarative aggregation (kasgeldRolling3Month) recomputes it daily from the GL short-term debt postings. The enforcement ladder runs binnen-norm → overschrijding-1-kwartaal → overschrijding-2-kwartalen → sanering-verplicht.

organisationId.description: FK to the organisation; reads scoped to the requesting user's organisation.
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

percentage.description: Statutory kasgeldlimiet percentage per organisatie-type, sourced from FidoNormcatalogus.
percentage.title: Percentage

currentExposure.description: Rolling 3-month average of net short-term debt; daily recompute via kasgeldRolling3Month aggregation.
currentExposure.title: Current Exposure

daysSinceLastBreach.description: Consecutive banking days since the last overschrijding cleared.
daysSinceLastBreach.title: Days Since Last Breach

kasgeldRolling3Month.description: Declarative shape of the daily kasgeldlimiet recompute. Sums net short-term debt = (opgenomen kasgeldleningen + rekening-courant draws + schuld RO + overige korte schuld < 1 jaar) − (korte vorderingen < 1 jaar) from the prior 90 banking days of GL short-term debt postings, divides by the number of banking days to obtain the rolling 3-month average, sets currentExposure and derives headroom = calculatedCeiling − currentExposure. status follows the enforcement ladder over consecutive quarters. When the engine cannot express the rolling window, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll) over the GL ledger.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Kasgeldlimiet is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

RenteRisicoNorm.title: Rente-risiconorm
RenteRisicoNorm.description: 4-year rolling interest-rate herfinanciering + rate-reset exposure ceiling per Wet Fido. Ceiling = 20% × uitstaande vaste schuld per 1 januari. The forward-looking 4-year per-year exposure is projected declaratively (renteRisico4YearProjection) from recorded Leningen with repayment schedules and floating-rate reset dates; a new lening whose forward exposure would breach 20% in any of the next four years is refused (or recorded with an override).

organisationId.description: FK to the organisation; reads scoped to the requesting user's organisation.
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

percentage.description: Statutory rente-risiconorm percentage; fixed at 20% per Wet Fido.
percentage.title: Percentage

forwardLooking4Year.description: Per-year projected herfinanciering + rate-reset exposure for the next four years.
forwardLooking4Year.title: Forward Looking4Year

status.description: Norm status: binnen-norm or overschrijding-jaar-N where N is the first breaching projection year.
status.title: Status

renteRisico4YearProjection.description: Declarative shape of the 4-year forward rente-risiconorm projection. Reads recorded Leningen with repaymentSchedule and floating-rate renteherzieningsmoment, projects per-year herfinanciering (maturing principal) + rate-reset volume for the next four years, sets forwardLooking4Year and derives headroomPerYear = ceiling − exposure per year. Recomputed on every lening-entry and floating-rate reset-event. When the engine cannot express the forward arithmetic, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll) over recorded Leningen.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Rente-risiconorm is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

SchatkistbankierenSaldo.title: Schatkistbankieren-saldo
SchatkistbankierenSaldo.description: Daily cash-park position to the Agentschap van de Generale Thesaurie (AGT) with drempelbedrag automation. drempelbedrag = max(0.75% × begrotingstotaal, €1,000,000) capped at €1bn (computed declaratively). When the rekening-courant saldo exceeds the drempelbedrag for the third consecutive banking day, the daily sweep job parks the excess to AGT; the sweep is idempotent. Sweep failures are logged for the audit trail and alert the treasurer.

organisationId.description: FK to the organisation; reads scoped to the requesting user's organisation.
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

thresholdAmount.description: Computed drempelbedrag = max(0.75% × baseBegroting, 1000000) capped at 1000000000.
thresholdAmount.title: Drempelbedrag

currentAccountCourant.title: Current Rekening Courant

daysAboveThreshold.title: Days Above Drempel

parkedAtTreasury.description: Amount parked at AGT in the latest sweep.
parkedAtTreasury.title: Parked At Schatkist

lastSweepErrorMessage.title: Last Sweep Error Message

submissionReceipt.description: Digital receipt number returned by AGT for the latest sweep.
submissionReceipt.title: Submission Receipt

Lening.title: Lening
Lening.description: Short-term (kasgeld) and long-term loans with instrument type, maturity and signing-mandate enforcement. At entry the lening is validated against the live kasgeldlimiet, rente-risiconorm and the adopted Treasurystatuut signing-mandate matrix; a breach is not hard-blocked but requires an override-rationale recorded in the audit trail (the FidoTreasuryGuard enforces the override precondition). Lifecycle: draft → recorded → locked.

organisationId.title: Organisation ID

rate.title: Rate

signingMandateRole.title: Signing Mandate Role

treasuryStatuteId.title: Treasurystatuut ID

Derivaat.title: Derivaat
Derivaat.description: Interest-rate swaps / caps / floors / collars restricted to hedging-only purposes per RUDDO. A derivaat may only be recorded with a RUDDOJustification demonstrating a hedge-relationship to an existing Lening or KasgeldPositie, a notional that does not exceed the hedged exposure, and a counterparty rating of single-A or better; speculative derivatives are never recorded. The FidoTreasuryGuard enforces these cross-field preconditions. Lifecycle: draft → recorded → matured.

organisationId.description: FK to the organisation; reads scoped to the requesting user's organisation.
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

notional.description: Notional amount; must not exceed the hedged exposure.
notional.title: Notional

hedgedExposureId.description: FK to the underlying Lening (or KasgeldPositie) being hedged; mandatory per RUDDO.
hedgedExposureId.title: Hedged Exposure ID

hedgedExposureAmount.title: Hedged Exposure Amount

marketValue.description: Mark-to-market value (negative for an unrealised loss).
marketValue.title: Market Value

RUDDOJustification.description: Narrative demonstrating the hedge-relationship per RUDDO Article 2. Mandatory; a derivaat without a hedging justification is never recorded.
RUDDOJustification.example: IRS to hedge floating-rate risk on the €10M floating-rate lening maturing 2028-06-30
RUDDOJustification.title: Ruddo Justification

counterpartyRating.description: Counterparty long-term credit rating; must be single-A or better per RUDDO.
counterpartyRating.title: Counterparty Rating

draft.label: Draft

recorded.label: Recorded
recorded.description: Passed RUDDO hedging-only validation; a valid hedge.

matured.description: Reached maturity; closed for the audit trail.

record.label: Record derivaat
record.description: Record the derivaat once RUDDO hedging-only validation passes: justification + hedge-link + notional ≤ hedged exposure + counterparty rating ≥ A.

mature.label: Mark matured
mature.description: Mark the derivaat matured at the end of its hedge term.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Derivaat is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

QuartaalrapportageFido.title: Kwartaalrapportage Fido
QuartaalrapportageFido.description: Verplichte kwartaalrapportage to the toezichthouder (provincie for gemeente, ministerie BZK for provincie/waterschap), auto-generated within 10 working days after quarter-end. Aggregates that quarter's leningen + derivaten mutations, kasgeldlimiet / rente-risiconorm / schatkistbankieren status snapshots and any overrides into the report (quarterlyFidoRollup), then requires co-sign by the treasurer and concerncontroller before transmission. The FidoTreasuryGuard enforces the dual sign-off submit precondition. Lifecycle: draft → signed → submitted → archived.

organisationId.title: Organisation ID

derivativesMovements.title: Derivaten Mutaties

quarterlyFidoRollup.description: Declarative shape of the quarterly-rapportage auto-generation. Aggregates the quarter's Leningen + Derivaten mutations, the closing kasgeldlimiet / rente-risiconorm / schatkistbankieren snapshots and the overridesApplied list into a draft rapportage on Day 10 after quarter-end. When the engine cannot express the cross-schema roll-up, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll).

TreasuryParagraaf.title: Treasury-paragraaf
TreasuryParagraaf.description: Jaarrekening treasury narrative & projection per BBV Article 13. Auto-populated from the current limiet-status, projected liquiditeit and the adopted Treasurystatuut narrative when the jaarrekening notes-renderer calls the data source; the concerncontroller may add a manual annotation. Lifecycle: draft → reviewed → published.

objects.narrativeAuto: Schatkistfunctie: Het kasgeldlimiet bedraagt 8,5% van de begroting (€17,0M). Het gemiddelde netto kortlopende schuld over Q4 was €16,8M; geen overschrijding. De rente-risiconorm (20% vaste schuld herfinancieringsrisico) toont geen overschrijding in de 4-jaars projectie. Dagelijks gemiddelde geparkt bij AGT: €0,3M. Treasurystatuut 2024 voorziet in risk-appetite "midden"; alle transacties voldoen aan de mandaatmatrix.
